title: Which Kind of Explorer Are You?
description: A personality quiz. Your answers add tags and the quiz branches to your result.

options.text: Out on the water at first light
Telescope on the roof, still up from last night

sea_extra.text: On the water, what are you in?

options.text: A kayak, close to the coast
Not knowing what is over the horizon

end_mountain.title: The Mountaineer
end_mountain.text: Determined and steady. You like a clear goal and the climb to reach it.

end_sea.title: The Navigator
end_sea.text: Adventurous and adaptable. You follow the horizon wherever it leads.

end_space.title: The Astronomer
end_space.text: Curious and thoughtful. You are driven by the biggest questions.

end_wanderer.title: The Wanderer
end_wanderer.text: You do not fit one mould: you mix a bit of everything, and that is a strength.
